mapper.sql: SELECT tax_id, company_id, ap_id, partner_id, partner_name, invoice_code, invoice_no, invoice_date, tax_rate, amount_excl_tax, tax_amount, deduct_status, deduct_period, voucher_id, dept_id, user_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM fin_input_tax
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_input_tax SET deduct_status = 'DEDUCTED', deduct_period = #{deductPeriod}, voucher_id = #{voucherId}, update_time = sysdate() WHERE tax_id = #{taxId} AND del_flag = '0' AND deduct_status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE fin_input_tax SET deduct_status = 'VOID', update_time = sysdate() WHERE tax_id = #{taxId} AND del_flag = '0' AND deduct_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE fin_input_tax SET deduct_status = 'EXPIRED', update_time = sysdate() WHERE del_flag = '0' AND deduct_status = 'PENDING' AND tax_amount > 0 AND invoice_date IS NOT NULL AND DATE_ADD(invoice_date, INTERVAL 12 MONTH) < #{today}
mapper.select: WHERE del_flag = '0' AND deduct_status = 'PENDING' AND tax_amount > 0 AND invoice_date IS NOT NULL AND DATE_ADD(invoice_date, INTERVAL 12 MONTH) >= #{today} AND DATE_ADD(invoice_date, INTERVAL 12 MONTH) < DATE_ADD(#{today}, INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY invoice_date LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fin_input_tax WHERE del_flag = '0' AND deduct_status = 'PENDING' AND invoice_date IS NOT NULL AND DATE_ADD(invoice_date, INTERVAL 12 MONTH) < #{today}

SELECT v.val_id, v.company_id, v.period, v.material_id, v.material_code, m.material_name, v.warehouse_id, v.qty, v.unit_cost, v.total_value, v.provision_amount, v.create_by, v.create_time, v.update_by, v.update_time, v.remark FROM fin_inventory_valuation v LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.material_id = v.material_id AND m.del_flag = '0'
AND v.period = #{period}
AND v.material_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{materialCode}, '%')
AND v.del_flag = '0'
ORDER BY v.period DESC, v.material_code

SELECT c.material_id AS materialId, c.material_code AS materialCode, c.material_name AS materialName, SUM(c.qty) AS qty, CASE WHEN SUM(c.qty) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(c.total_cost) / SUM(c.qty), 4) END AS unitCost, SUM(c.total_cost) AS totalValue, IFNULL((SELECT SUM(v.provision_amount) FROM fin_inventory_valuation v WHERE v.material_id = c.material_id AND v.del_flag = '0'), 0) AS alreadyProvision FROM fin_inventory_cost c WHERE c.del_flag = '0' AND c.qty > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fin_inventory_valuation v2 WHERE v2.material_id = c.material_id AND v2.period = #{period} AND v2.del_flag = '0' ) GROUP BY c.material_id, c.material_code, c.material_name ORDER BY totalValue DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_inventory_valuation SET provision_amount = 0, update_time = sysdate(), remark = CONCAT(IFNULL(remark, ''), ' [已冲回]') WHERE val_id = #{valId} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(total_value) AS totalValue, SUM(provision_amount) AS provisionAmount FROM fin_inventory_valuation WHERE period = #{period} AND del_flag = '0'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(provision_amount), 0) FROM fin_inventory_valuation WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND del_flag = '0'
